//Serilog: Read by ReadFrom.Configuration in Program.cs, which adds these sinks alongside the Console
sink written there in code. The file sink exists because the collector's normal home is a
gaming PC, started before a race and not watched: without it every dropped batch, reconnect
warning and crash trace lives only in a console window that is behind a fullscreen game and
gone once it closes. Rolling daily and capped at 14 files so an unattended machine cannot
fill its disk. shared:true because the path is fixed rather than per-process, so a second
collector started by accident logs instead of failing to open the file.
